 Italian-made GTA 6 companion offers interactive map and source-backed tracker
 ⓘ Rockstar Games GTA 6: Jason and Lucia overlooking Vice City An independent Italian developer has created a free GTA 6 companion site featuring an interactive map, progress tracking and sourced news. Players can use it without an account, although the map is still being populated. The website also includes a wiki covering characters, locations and vehicles, along with a regional release-time calculator. Aurelian Nedelcu , Published 11/18/2026 🇩🇪 🇪🇸 ... 
 🇵🇹 🇮🇹 🇳🇱 🇫🇷 🇵🇱 🇹🇷 🇭🇺 🇨🇳 🇸🇪 Gaming

 With Grand Theft Auto VI arriving on November 19, half of the planet is preparing to explore Vice City and the fictional state of Leonida. An Italian developer named Alex has been working on Leonida Guide, a free, independent companion designed to make that enormous virtual playground a little easier to navigate. 
 His website , available in English and Italian, combines an interactive map with a 100% completion tracker. Players can search for locations, filter landmarks, missions, activities and collectibles, then mark completed objectives. Progress is stored locally, so no account is required. Moving between devices is possible using a QR code or a synchronization code. 
 As always, there’s a catch. Or let me call it an important limitation. The map currently contains only 20 demonstration markers rather than verified in-game locations. Its underlying geography is based on an unofficial community reconstruction, with actual collectibles and mission details scheduled to appear as they're discovered after launch. In other words, don't start hunting for treasure just yet.
 ⓘ Leonida Guide GTA 6 Leonida Guide concept map with locations, missions and collectibles 
 The Leonida Guide also includes a wiki covering characters, locations, vehicles and other information. Its news section distinguishes confirmed announcements from leaks and rumors, with references to original sources. Another useful feature is the regional release-time calculator, which converts PlayStation Store unlock times into different time zones which can help you calculate what will be the launch time in your region. Rockstar has confirmed that GTA 6 launches at midnight local time on November 19 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S . 
 Leonida Guide isn't affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. Whether it becomes an indispensable companion will depend on how quickly its information catches up with the millions of players exploring Leonida.
